key: Assassin - Special Edition (1993)(Team 17)[cr DLM][t +19 HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$1600 to $078000 (5632 bytes):0:02D2

key: Assassin - Special Edition (1993)(Team 17)[cr DLM][t +19 HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$1600 to $078000 (5632 bytes):0:057C

key: Assassin - Special Edition (1993)(Team 17)[cr DLM][t +19 HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$1600 to $078000 (5632 bytes):0:05D4

key: Assassin - Special Edition (1993)(Team 17)[cr DLM][t +19 HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$1600 to $078000 (5632 bytes):0:0718

key: Assassin - Special Edition (1993)(Team 17)[cr DLM][t +19 HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$1600 to $078000 (5632 bytes):0:074A

key: Assassin - Special Edition (1993)(Team 17)[cr DLM][t +19 HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$1600 to $078000 (5632 bytes):0:0760

key: Assassin - Special Edition (1993)(Team 17)[cr DLM][t +19 HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$1600 to $078000 (5632 bytes):0:0774

key: Assassin - Special Edition (1993)(Team 17)[cr DLM][t +19 HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$1600 to $078000 (5632 bytes):0:078E

key: Assassin - Special Edition (1993)(Team 17)[cr DLM][t +19 HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$1600 to $078000 (5632 bytes):0:07E8

key: Assassin - Special Edition (1993)(Team 17)[cr DLM][t +19 HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$1600 to $078000 (5632 bytes):0:0820

key: Assassin - Special Edition (1993)(Team 17)[cr DLM][t +19 HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$1600 to $078000 (5632 bytes):0:086A
name: start_disk_dma_with_sync

key: Assassin - Special Edition (1993)(Team 17)[cr DLM][t +19 HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$1600 to $078000 (5632 bytes):0:08A8

key: Assassin - Special Edition (1993)(Team 17)[cr DLM][t +19 HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$1600 to $078000 (5632 bytes):0:08E0
name: write_control_register_for_flag

key: Assassin - Special Edition (1993)(Team 17)[cr DLM][t +19 HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$1600 to $078000 (5632 bytes):0:08F0
name: set_ciab_port_bit

key: Assassin - Special Edition (1993)(Team 17)[cr DLM][t +19 HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$1600 to $078000 (5632 bytes):0:090E

key: Assassin - Special Edition (1993)(Team 17)[cr DLM][t +19 HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$1600 to $078000 (5632 bytes):0:0926

key: Assassin - Special Edition (1993)(Team 17)[cr DLM][t +19 HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$1600 to $078000 (5632 bytes):0:0974

key: Assassin - Special Edition (1993)(Team 17)[cr DLM][t +19 HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$1600 to $078000 (5632 bytes):0:09A8
name: set_ciab_control_and_wait

key: Assassin - Special Edition (1993)(Team 17)[cr DLM][t +19 HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$1600 to $078000 (5632 bytes):0:09CC

key: Assassin - Special Edition (1993)(Team 17)[cr DLM][t +19 HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$1600 to $078000 (5632 bytes):0:09D6

key: Assassin - Special Edition (1993)(Team 17)[cr DLM][t +19 HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$1600 to $078000 (5632 bytes):0:0A06
name: wait_for_cia_timer_result

key: Assassin - Special Edition (1993)(Team 17)[cr DLM][t +19 HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$1600 to $078000 (5632 bytes):0:0A18
name: write_ciab_timer_sequence

key: Assassin - Special Edition (1993)(Team 17)[cr DLM][t +19 HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$1600 to $078000 (5632 bytes):0:0A26
name: set_ciab_timer

key: Assassin - Special Edition (1993)(Team 17)[cr DLM][t +19 HLM](Disk 1 of 2).adf boot-block load +$1600 to $078000 (5632 bytes):0:0A48
name: locate_position_in_rows

name: lookup_table_word_and_mask
description: Reads a 16-bit word from a fixed table at an address built from twice a register index, then ANDs it with a second register value and returns the result.

name: configure_audio_channels
description: Writes the audio period register for channel 0 and the location register for channel 3, and writes the DMA control register. The decompiler timed out, so the exact sequence is not confirmed beyond these listed register writes.

name: set_stored_byte_if_changed
description: Compares an input byte with a stored byte and, when they differ, stores the new byte and calls an initialization routine in the runtime segment.

name: clear_runtime_state_after_setup
description: Calls a setup routine four times, then clears several global variables and the stored callback, sets one global to 15, and clears two more. The listed hardware touch is the DMA control register.

name: call_pointer_if_global_zero
description: When a global variable is zero, it calls the function whose address is read through that variable, then calls another routine. Otherwise it does nothing.

name: call_global_function_pointer
description: Calls the function whose address is read through a global variable, then returns. The listing is reached only from a gap that decodes as code, so its caller is not confirmed.

name: read_packed_bit_fields
description: Makes three calls in sequence, one of which is the depacker bit reader that collects a set number of bits from the packed stream. The listing does not show what the other two calls do.

name: compute_table_value_and_store
description: Calculates an index from a global variable, reads a word from a table at that index, and stores the result of subtracting it and a low nibble from a constant into a global variable.

name: process_object_position_lists
description: Walks a list of object records, skipping empty ones, and for each one walks its position entries until a sentinel value. It adds each entry's offsets to the object coordinates, calls a routine for every entry, and writes a sentinel at the end of the list.

name: initialize_and_clip_object
description: Fills an object record from a definition table, setting its coordinates from the input position plus scroll offsets and a few fixed fields. It adjusts the coordinates when they fall outside limits of 248 and 368, and copies a block of 20 words when a further condition holds.

name: blit_object_list_entries
description: For each record in a list, waits until the blitter is not busy, then loads the blitter source and destination pointers, modulo values and control registers from the record. It sets a fixed size value and starts the blit.

name: blit_masked_object_rows
description: For each record in a list, waits for the blitter to become free, then programs its pointers, modulo values, control registers and first and last word masks. It sets the blit size and starts the operation.

name: clear_fixed_long_table
description: Clears 260 consecutive longwords starting from a fixed address in the runtime segment.

name: initialize_state_then_spin
description: Clears and sets several global variables and constants, calls initialization routines, and then enters an endless loop. The listing is reached only from a gap that decodes as code.

name: initialize_copper_and_interrupts
description: Calls an initialization routine, sets three global values, and writes the high word of the first copper list pointer. It then calls another routine and writes two fixed values to the DMA and interrupt enable registers.

name: initialize_eight_global_words
description: Stores the same constant, 8228, into eight consecutive global word variables.

name: read_interrupt_request_bits
description: Reads the interrupt request register, clears its top bit, and stores the result in a global variable. It returns the data register value it was given. The listing is reached only from a gap that decodes as code.

name: handle_interrupt_requests
description: Reads the interrupt request register. For the copper interrupt bit it runs five helper routines and sets a state byte; for the vertical blank bit it runs helpers, advances two 16-bit counters and records the state; otherwise it stores the masked request value.

name: split_longwords_into_memory_block
description: Takes eight longwords from a global array and writes the low and high word of each into alternate positions of eight-byte slots in a memory block starting at a fixed address.

name: set_global_to_constant
description: Stores the constant 8192 into a global variable and returns. The listed interrupt request register touch does not appear in the pseudo-code.

name: read_ports_update_state
description: Calls two helpers, which the listing does not name but which are presumably the port decoders, then updates a global state byte. It sets bit 7 when bit 6 is clear, forces bit 7 on, and always leaves the byte set to 1.

name: decode_word_flags_into_byte
description: Reads a word and derives four flag bits from it: two from exclusive-OR combinations of neighbouring bits and two from single bits at fixed positions. It writes the four-bit value into a byte.

name: advance_table_check_countdown
description: Checks one table entry against a global value and the next entry against a sentinel. When both match it resets the index, counts a global word down from 28672 one step at a time, and toggles bit 0 of a global variable.

name: compute_layer_addresses
description: Derives scroll-based values from two global coordinates and lookup tables, then computes base addresses for two layers, choosing one of two base pairs according to a flag bit. For each layer it stores the low and high words of four offset addresses into a global buffer.

name: process_callback_pointer_flags
description: Checks the low four bits of a stored value and calls a routine for each bit that is set, then clears the stored value to zero.

name: execute_callback_table
description: Calls the function whose address is at the current position of a pointer table, advances the pointer by one entry, and wraps back to the table start when a negative sentinel is reached.

name: execute_callback_table
description: Calls the function whose address is at the current position of a pointer table, advances the pointer by one entry, and wraps back to the table start when a negative sentinel is reached.

name: execute_callback_table
description: Calls the function whose address is at the current position of a pointer table, advances the pointer by one entry, and wraps back to the table start when a negative sentinel is reached.

name: execute_callback_table
description: Calls the function whose address is at the current position of a pointer table, advances the pointer by one entry, and wraps back to the table start when a negative sentinel is reached.

name: initialize_request_record
description: Chooses one of two record bases according to a flag, sets two fields to zero and one, and stores the input register value and a second argument into later fields. It returns the input byte with bits 2 and 3 set.

name: fill_request_record_with_value
description: Chooses one of two record bases according to a flag, sets two fields to one, and stores the input longword and two further values into later fields. The listing is reached only from a gap that decodes as code.

name: store_record_header_fields
description: Writes a flag word of one and a zero word into a record addressed by the A4 register, then stores the input word into a third field and the input longword into a later field.

name: store_record_fields_with_long
description: Writes one into two words of a record addressed by the A4 register, stores a longword from the data register and an input word and longword into later fields. The listing is reached only from a gap that decodes as code.

name: set_blitter_modulos_from_offset
description: Calls a helper, then when a state word is nonzero and a flag word is zero, waits for the blitter to be idle and sets the blitter A and D modulo registers to twice the difference between 24 and an offset. It then sets the state word to 96; the listing ends in a decompiler stop marker, so its tail is unconfirmed.

name: reset_record_and_set_modulos
description: Clears a record's first word when it is nonzero. If its second word is zero, it waits for the blitter to be idle and sets the blitter modulo registers from a value derived from 24 minus an offset, then sets the bits 96 in the record; the listing ends in a decompiler stop marker, so its tail is unconfirmed.

name: link_list_head_to_self
description: Stores the address held in the A4 register at that same address, making a self-referencing list head, then calls five routines. The called routines are not named in the listing.

name: initialize_pointer_tables
description: Fills two tables of six entries each with sequential address values that step by 736 bytes. The high word is written at offset 2 and the low word at offset 6 of each 8-byte entry.

name: clear_strided_structure_words
description: Writes zero to a two-byte field in each of sixteen structures spaced 46 bytes apart, starting at a fixed address.

name: step_counter_toward_target
description: Moves a global counter one step toward a target value, clamping negative values to zero. When the counter increases it zeroes two bytes in a table row, and when it decreases it sets them to 255, with the row chosen from the counter.

name: copy_row_to_triple_buffer
description: Clamps a global byte to a maximum of nine and uses it to pick a row of a table with 24-byte rows. It copies eight three-byte entries from that row into three destination buffers, stepping 46 bytes per entry, with the second buffer 736 bytes on and the third 1472 bytes on from the first.

name: decrement_and_invoke_callback
description: If a stored callback address is nonzero, it moves that address back by one byte and calls the routine there.

name: decrement_and_invoke_callback
description: If a stored callback address is nonzero, it moves that address back by one byte and calls the routine there.

name: increment_call_and_execute_next
description: Adds one byte to a stored callback address, calls the routine at that new address, then calls a second routine at a fixed address.

name: add_to_bcd_counter
description: Splits a 32-bit input into its four bytes and adds each one to the matching byte of a decimal counter, adjusting each result as packed decimal. It stores the original value and then calls one routine.

name: advance_index_until_threshold
description: Advances a global index by one while the longword at that index in a global array is below a threshold, then calls one further routine. The listing does not show the routine it calls.

name: set_global_and_call_four
description: Stores the value 4 in a global variable and then makes four calls to other routines, which the listing does not name.

name: update_countdown_and_call_routine
description: When a global countdown byte is zero, it returns early if two stored values match; otherwise it copies one value over the other and resets the countdown to four. When the countdown is nonzero it decrements it, and every path except the early return increments a second counter and calls one routine.

name: call_routine_twice
description: Calls the same routine twice in succession and then returns. The routine it calls is not named in the listing.

name: copy_row_to_three_planes
description: Copies eight three-byte entries from a table row selected by the input register into three destination planes. It steps the destination 46 bytes per entry and offsets the second and third planes by 736 and 1472 bytes.

name: copy_nibble_rows_to_buffer
description: Uses the high and low nibbles of a global byte to select two table rows. It writes 16 entries from each row into two destination columns, with the second column 736 bytes on.

name: copy_nibble_rows_to_planes
description: Copies three table rows, each chosen by a different nibble of a global word, into three destination planes. It returns 65535 when the word is 513 or more; otherwise it returns a stack argument when two global values differ, and the first value when they match.

name: decrement_bcd_counter_periodically
description: When a global flag is clear and another value is not 16, it counts a frame counter down. When the counter drops below zero it resets it to 25 and, if a stored value is nonzero, subtracts a second value from it as packed decimal, then stores the result and calls routines.

name: increment_char_when_globals_match
description: When two global bytes match, it adds 48 to one of them and corrects the sum when it exceeds 88 and is not 89. It stores the value and calls one routine.

name: initialize_or_reset_data_blocks
description: When a counter is below 33, it decrements the counter and writes an all-ones or all-zeros pattern into eight entries spaced 46 bytes apart, choosing all-ones when bit 1 of the counter is set. Otherwise, when a global is zero, it writes all-ones to the same eight entries.

name: compact_and_dispatch_entries
description: Compacts a sentinel-terminated list by copying its nonzero entries forward and skipping zero runs. It then calls a routine chosen from a function table by a byte field for each entry, clears entries whose byte field is zero, and returns the last call's word result.

name: append_to_object_list
description: Stores a pointer in the next slot of a global list and writes a sentinel value of minus one after it, then advances the list end.

name: check_object_collisions_with_others
description: Walks the global object pointer list up to its sentinel. For each active object whose type byte differs from the input object's type, it calls one routine.

name: calculate_object_distance_or_collision
description: Looks up type-specific base data for two objects and computes a signed offset between their positions, using constants as adjustments. When the first result is negative, it recomputes along another combination and returns that value when its conditions hold.

name: store_long_into_type_slot
description: Writes a 32-bit value as two 16-bit halves into an array slot. The slot offset is the type byte of an object record times eight, with the halves at offsets 4 and 6. The listing is reached only from a gap that decodes as code.

name: decrement_countdown_byte
description: Decrements a countdown byte when it is nonzero and returns. The code after that check, which walks a table and calls a routine, appears unreachable in the decompiler output and is not described.

name: run_nibble_adjustment_passes
description: Clears a global byte, calls an external routine, then calls a routine 32 times in a loop. The listing is reached only from a gap that decodes as code.

name: adjust_nibbles_toward_target
description: Compares each of the three nibble fields of a word, at bits 0 to 3, 4 to 7 and 8 to 11, with the matching field of a target word. Where they differ it moves that field one step toward the target.

name: allocate_visible_object_slots
description: Either visits a grid of cells around the scroll position and calls routines for each occupied cell, or scans object entries against a rectangle. For entries inside the rectangle it takes a free record from a pool of 14 records, 52 bytes each, initializes it from the entry's position and type, and calls two routines. It stops when the pool is full.

name: spawn_object_in_slot
description: Walks the entry list and, for each entry inside a rectangle that is not already active, takes a free record from a pool of 14 and initializes it with the entry's position and type. It marks the entry as taken, calls two routines, and stops early when the pool is full.

name: update_object_animation_frame
description: Sets an object's frame counter to one less than its type's count, unless that count is minus one. It sets the step size from a type field shifted by a global value, doubled when a flag is zero, and increments a global counter for types above 63 whose frame counter is not minus one.

name: check_bounds_and_call_fallback
description: Tests two 16-bit values in the record against limits that are fixed offsets from a code address. When both lie in range it returns the difference from the second limit; otherwise it clears a flag byte at the pointer stored in the record and returns the result of a fallback routine.

name: check_bounds_and_call_fallback
description: Tests two 16-bit values in the record against limits that are fixed offsets from a code address. When both lie in range it returns the difference from the second limit; otherwise it clears a flag byte at the pointer stored in the record and returns the result of a fallback routine.

name: return_without_action
description: The decompiler output is an empty body that only returns. The listing reports 15 instructions that the pseudo-code does not show.

name: compare_position_and_store_flags
description: Compares a position field against a limit that depends on the sign of another field, and returns the difference. When the comparison meets its condition it stores two input bytes into record fields. The listing is reached only from an unreached gap.

name: compute_difference_and_store_bytes
description: Subtracts a record position from a limit and a second input value, returning the difference. When the difference is non-negative it stores two input bytes into record fields.

name: calculate_address_with_scaled_offset
description: If a sign field in the record is negative, it adds an extra offset to the base value. It then combines a record byte, shifted by a count, with a masked input word, scales the result by eight, and stores the sum as the record's first longword.

name: fetch_scaled_table_longword
description: If a sign field in the record is negative, it adds an offset to the base address. It then forms an index from a record byte shifted by a count and combined with an input word, scales it by four, and stores the longword at that address in the record. The listing is reached only from an unreached gap.

name: update_position_with_table_lookup
description: Stores its inputs in globals, then calls a helper that returns flag bits. Depending on those flags it adds a value to a record field or snaps a coordinate to a 16-unit grid using a lookup table indexed by a masked position, looping until the flags stop asking for another step.

name: call_two_helper_routines
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns. The routines are not named in the listing.

name: perform_24bit_addition_and_store
description: Adds a signed word at offset 20 to a 24-bit value split between the word at offset 16 and the byte at offset 24, then stores the result back in those two fields.

name: add_word_to_24bit_value
description: Adds a signed word at offset 22 to a 24-bit value split between the word at offset 18 and the byte at offset 26, then stores the result back in those two fields.

name: calculate_global_offset_difference
description: Returns the global variable plus 26, minus a word read from offset 18 of the record. The listing is reached only from an unreached gap.

name: initialize_object_record_fields
description: Returns early when a flag is set or a value is below a limit. Otherwise it fills a new object record with cleared fields, coordinate offsets taken from the inputs and type data, then calls two routines and returns the last result.

name: run_short_delay_loop
description: Counts a 16-bit counter down from 14 to minus one, which is a short busy-wait delay.

name: scan_entries_for_zero_byte
description: Walks up to 15 records of 52 bytes at a fixed address and stops at the first one whose byte at offset 42 is zero. It returns no value.

name: clamp_fields_symmetric_range
description: Limits the signed word at offset 20 to the range from minus the first input value to that value, and the word at offset 22 to the range from minus the second input value to that value.

name: initialize_structure_with_register_values
description: Writes two longword inputs into the first two longwords of a record, adds a word input to the word at offset 18, and copies two of those words into later fields.

name: update_timer_counters
description: Depending on a global flag, either decrements a set of counters or steps a secondary counter while adjusting values through a pointer table. It then clamps each counter to zero or above and loads a table word indexed by each counter.

name: initialize_object_slot
description: Finds the first free slot among 20 records of 52 bytes at a fixed address. It copies coordinates from a source record, sets offsets from a global flag value, sets the type byte to 5, calls a routine, and increments a global counter.

name: advance_object_state_machine
description: Advances a three-state machine stored in an object record. The first state returns early when global counters exceed limits, otherwise it moves on and saves an index in the record; the second state calls a routine and advances when a flag is set; the third state writes a pointer computed from the saved index into the record's first longword.

name: check_pointers_advance_index
description: Compares the first word referred to by two table pointers at the record's current index, and returns at the first mismatch. Otherwise it advances the index with wrap-around, repeating up to three times.

name: reset_globals_and_fill_table
description: Calls routines in a loop until one returns zero, then clears four globals and a stored callback. It writes minus-one into three longwords of each of 16 entries spaced 46 bytes apart, starting at a fixed address, then calls a final routine. The listing is reached only from an unreached gap.

name: call_two_then_store_global
description: Calls two routines in sequence, then copies a global variable into a stored callback location and returns. The called routines are not named in the listing.

name: process_game_tasks_and_handlers
description: Checks global state flags and a pair of counters before processing. It advances a task counter and, once that passes a threshold, calls handler routines from a table, saves a slot index and decrements a pending counter. It also decreases a countdown when it is nonzero.

name: write_mirrored_pattern_buffers
description: Clamps a counter at 47 and writes one of eight global bytes, selected by the low three bits of the counter, into a column of 16 rows spaced 46 bytes apart in two mirrored buffers. It writes 255 into those rows when the counter is below 40.

name: find_next_valid_handler
description: Scans up to six entries of a handler pointer table starting at the stored index, wrapping at the end. It stores the index of the first non-null entry it finds.

name: clear_entries_to_negative_one
description: Writes minus one into one longword in each of 16 entries spaced 46 bytes apart, starting at an offset computed from an input index, then returns the input word unchanged.

name: clear_indexed_data_block
description: Writes zero to one longword in each of 16 entries spaced 46 bytes apart, starting at an offset computed from a global index, then returns the input word unchanged.

name: fill_table_with_negative_one
description: Writes minus one into three longwords of each of 16 entries spaced 46 bytes apart, starting from a fixed address.

name: fill_table_with_zero
description: Writes zero into three longwords of each of 16 entries spaced 46 bytes apart, starting from a fixed address.

name: copy_pairs_to_interleaved_buffers
description: Uses an input index, capped at nine, to select a 32-byte block from a table. It copies sixteen byte pairs from that block into two interleaved buffers, stepping 46 bytes per pair, with the second buffer 736 bytes on from the first.

name: process_task_slot_handlers
description: Walks five task slots and, for each slot with a nonzero counter, decrements the counter and calls one of two handler routines chosen by the counter's parity. It saves the slot index and stored handler value before the loop and restores them afterwards.

name: process_task_slot_handlers
description: Walks five task slots and, for each slot with a nonzero counter, decrements the counter and calls one of two handler routines chosen by the counter's parity. It saves the slot index and stored handler value before the loop and restores them afterwards.

name: process_task_slot_handlers
description: Walks five task slots and, for each slot with a nonzero counter, decrements the counter and calls one of two handler routines chosen by the counter's parity. It saves the slot index and stored handler value before the loop and restores them afterwards.

name: start_task_handler_from_table
description: Decrements one byte of a counter table and, when a global flag is clear, calls three routines. It then calls a fixed routine, sets a countdown to 25, and calls a handler selected from a function table by a global index.

name: call_function_from_table
description: Calls the function whose address is in a pointer table at the position given by a global index, then returns.

name: dispatch_id_with_counter
description: When a global flag is set it delegates to a helper. Otherwise it compares an input value against several ranges, delegating to helpers for most of them. For one high range it increments a counter, returns its low seven bits, and clears a global when the counter reaches a multiple of 128.

name: call_routine_when_flagged
description: When a global flag is nonzero, calls one routine. The listing is reached only from an unreached gap.

name: return_without_action
description: The body only returns and does nothing. The listing is reached only from an unreached gap.

name: mark_node_and_store_handler
description: If a visited flag at offset 43 is clear, it sets the flag, calls a helper, and stores a handler address derived from the byte at offset 42, minus 20 and scaled by eight, into the record's first longword. It then calls three routines.

name: check_and_update_object_state
description: When the status byte at offset 42 equals 4, it increments a counter table entry chosen by a byte from a second record and stores 16 into a global table at the index returned by a helper. It then clears a flag and sets the second record's status byte to 30, and calls a routine. The listing is reached only from an unreached gap.

name: advance_countdown_pointer_state
description: Initializes a record's state byte and calls a helper on first use. While the state byte equals 1 it stores a pointer derived from another record byte into the first longword and decrements a countdown; when the countdown goes negative it returns, otherwise it writes 65280 into the word at offset 22 and calls a routine. Several self-assignment statements do nothing.

name: set_record_word_and_call
description: Writes 65280 into the word at offset 22 of the record addressed by the A0 register, then calls one routine.

name: decrement_global_with_floor
description: Decrements a global counter when it is nonzero and clamps it to zero if the result goes negative.

name: initialize_object_when_global_matches
description: When a global value equals 150, it calls an initialization routine. If that routine's status byte is zero, it stores two values at offsets 16 and 18 of the target record.

name: initialize_globals_and_call_function
description: Copies a global variable into two other globals, sets two further globals to 120 and 45, calls a function through a global function pointer, and then performs a self-assignment that does nothing.

name: clear_state_then_call_routines
description: Clears three global variables and one more global, then makes nineteen calls to routines that the listing does not name.

name: conditionally_decrement_global_pointer
description: When a global counter byte is zero and a second global exceeds 69, it increments the counter. When the counter then becomes a multiple of four, it moves a global pointer back by two.

name: evaluate_conditions_and_call_routine
description: Tests a global flag byte and a nonzero field of the record. When the conditions hold it calls a routine and returns its result, after bit tests whose branches all make that call; otherwise it returns the global flag value.

name: update_object_flags_and_timers
description: When a global mode byte is zero it clears the record's state. Otherwise it selects a value from a table by index, sets or clears flag bits and a countdown field according to bit tests on the mode byte, and calls one routine the listing does not name when an event flag is set.

name: reset_flag_and_call_five
description: When a counter equals zero, it clears a global variable and makes five calls to routines that the listing does not name.

name: reset_velocity_update_state
description: When a global mode value equals one, it clears two velocity fields and masks the low four bits off a position field. It then adds 15 to that position, or decrements a global counter when a flag bit is set, and loads a longword from a table indexed by the global value.

name: check_table_bits_clear_global
description: Calls a table lookup routine and clears a global variable when bit 2 or bit 5 of its result is set.

name: test_table_bits_set_flag
description: Calls a table lookup and tests bit pairs in its result, choosing the pair according to bit 3 of a record flag byte. When the matching pair is present it sets a global variable to one, and when bit 7 of the result is set it does nothing.

name: process_entity_state_conditions
description: When a global state is one and a flag bit is set, it tests two lookup results. Depending on a record flag, it either moves the global state to two, loads timer values and calls a routine, or advances the record's position by two and sets a state byte while clearing a global counter.

name: decrement_timer_and_process_callback
description: Counts down a global timer and reloads it to 16 when it is set. When the timer reaches zero it calls a helper, and depending on that result's bits it either clears two record fields and sets a global state to two, or reloads the timer.

name: process_scripted_sequence_step
description: When a counter is nonzero, it clears a record field and stores a byte from a global table, indexed by a quarter of the counter, into the record. When the counter reaches a set value and global conditions hold, it adjusts a function pointer by arithmetic on record fields; otherwise it decrements the counter and clears the global when it reaches zero.

name: call_two_helper_routines
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns. The routines are not named in the listing.

name: apply_flag_on_timeout
description: When the timer at offset 20 is negative, it runs a lookup and stops unless bit 3 of the result is set, or the field at offset 22 is positive and a second lookup has bit 3 set. Then it clears the low four bits of the word at offset 16, sets bit 2 there, and clears the timer.

name: apply_flags_from_timer_lookup
description: When the timer at offset 20 is positive, it runs a lookup. If bit 3 is set it clears the low four bits of the word at offset 16, sets them to ten, and clears the timer. Otherwise, when the field at offset 22 is positive, it runs a second lookup and, if bit 3 is set, sets bit 2 in the same word and clears the timer.

name: decrement_global_if_nonzero
description: Decrements a global byte variable when it is not zero. The listing is reached only from an unreached gap.

name: update_object_state_conditionally
description: Checks a position field against a limit and a lookup flag, returning early when the object should stay as it is. Otherwise it stores a callback pointer, sets a state byte and clears two timer fields, calls two routines, clears the callback pointer, and calls a final routine.

name: step_object_vertical_state
description: Clears a state byte and, when a position field passes a limit, zeroes two fields. Depending on a direction byte it adds 16 to a field and calls a routine, or subtracts 32, calls a routine and sets a frame value from a counter; when that counter reaches zero it sets two globals to 4 and 1.

name: increment_field_and_set_flag
description: Adds 16 to a field at offset 22 of the record, calls one routine, and sets a global flag to one if it was zero.

name: decrement_structure_byte_if_nonzero
description: Decrements the byte at offset 50 of the record when it is not zero.

name: stream_bytes_with_delay_counter
description: When a delay counter is nonzero it decrements it and returns. Otherwise, when a stored state is zero, it reads a global value and returns its low six bits if they are set; if not, it points a table pointer at a block chosen by two bits of that value. It then stores a table byte, indexed by a counter, into the record at offset 46 and decrements the counter. The listing is reached only from an unreached gap.

name: stream_table_bytes_into_structure
description: Stores a table byte, indexed by a counter, into the record at offset 46 and decrements the counter. When the counter is zero it first reads a global value, returns its low six bits if they are set, and otherwise selects a table block from two of its bits and resets the counter to 63. The listing is reached only from an unreached gap.

name: decay_timer_toward_zero
description: Returns the flag bits 2 and 3 of a global byte, after moving the timer at offset 20 toward zero by 60 per call. When the timer reaches or passes zero it is cleared together with the field at offset 24.

name: decay_timer_when_flagged
description: When bits 2 and 3 of a global byte are both set, it moves the timer at offset 20 toward zero by 60 per call, clearing it and the field at offset 24 when it crosses zero. The listing is reached only from an unreached gap.

name: decay_timer_when_bit3_set
description: When bit 3 of a global byte is set, it moves the timer at offset 20 toward zero by 60 per call, clearing it and the field at offset 24 when it crosses zero. The listing is reached only from an unreached gap.

name: set_next_routine_from_position
description: When a global value is nonzero and its magnitude exceeds 768, it selects a next-routine byte from a table, indexed by a value derived from the object's state byte. Otherwise, when a field at offset 22 is negative, it sets a routine identifier of 104 or 106 according to a flag bit.

name: update_object_with_global_counter
description: Performs several memory copies through address registers that the listing does not identify. Then, when a flag is clear and a counter is nonzero, it writes the counter to the record at offset 46 and decrements it; when the counter goes negative it loads the next pair of values from a stream pointer and calls a routine if the second value is 3. If the flag is set it resets the counter to zero.

name: update_object_with_global_counter
description: When a flag is clear and a counter is nonzero, it writes the counter to the record at offset 46 and decrements it. When the counter goes negative it loads the next pair of values from a stream pointer and calls a routine if the second value is 3. If the flag is set it resets the counter to zero.

name: update_velocity_with_clamping
description: Chooses an acceleration limit and step from flag bits and the object's direction flags, then moves the horizontal velocity toward zero or toward that limit. It clamps the vertical velocity field to 1536 in either direction and updates the state from two flag tests.

name: call_two_helper_routines
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns. The routines are not named in the listing.

name: integrate_horizontal_position
description: Adds the horizontal velocity word at offset 20 to a 24-bit position split between the word at offset 16 and the byte at offset 24. When the state byte equals four it first clamps the velocity to a range from minus 1280 to 1280.

name: add_word_to_24bit_value
description: Adds a signed word at offset 22 to a 24-bit value split between the word at offset 18 and the byte at offset 26, then stores the result back in those two fields.

name: compute_object_state_value
description: When the word at offset 20 is zero and no global flags block it, it builds a base value of 82 increased by flag-bit contributions and the record's flag byte, stores its low byte in the state byte, and returns it. Otherwise it returns a masked global value, and for a large velocity-like value with a clear global it may set a state value and call a routine.

name: initialize_state_from_table_entry
description: Chooses a source entry from a table when a stored pointer is unset or a flag is set, derives start offsets and limits from its values, and assigns a set of global state variables to defaults. It then calls a routine three times. The listing is reached only from an unreached gap.

name: initialize_state_from_record
description: Copies two values from an input structure into globals, sets default limits, and sets a global from an indexed table lookup. It resets several state variables and calls a routine three times. The listing is reached only from an unreached gap.

name: initialize_entity_state_from_data
description: Reads two values from an input structure, derives coordinate offsets and table indices with limits of zero, and sets several global state variables to defaults. It then calls a routine three times.

name: clamp_global_return_delta
description: Clamps a global value to a minimum of 16 and to a maximum given by another global, clearing a flag bit each time a bound is applied. It returns the signed difference from a second limit.

name: adjust_position_with_flags
description: When a state condition holds and the level index is not 16, it computes signed offsets between a position value and reference values. It clamps each offset's magnitude to eight, subtracts them from the position, and sets flag bits 3, 2, 1 and 0 as each adjustment applies.

name: clamp_position_within_bounds
description: Clamps a global position value between two reference bounds, clearing a companion counter when a bound is applied, and returns the remaining difference from a third bound.

name: update_entity_position_loop
description: Loops over a position update. When a global flag is set it adds 28 to a velocity-like field and returns; otherwise it reads a table value from a position-based index, aligns a coordinate to a 16-unit grid and applies the offset. When a bound is crossed it updates flags and may call routines.

name: lookup_table_entry
description: Computes an index from two input registers using shifts and masks, scaled by a global value, then fetches a word through a chained table and returns it.

name: update_sprite_frame_positions
description: When a sprite-state flag is clear, it selects a frame value from a counter and a table and writes coordinate words for two sprites, offset by 16 and minus 16. When the flag is set it writes the constant 8228 into four words. When the counter reaches a particular value it also fills 32 entries with 4095 and calls a routine.

name: build_sprite_control_records
description: Computes sprite screen coordinates from an object position minus a base value, sets flag bits from wrap conditions, and writes a four-byte sprite control record. It writes an identical copy 216 bytes further on.

name: build_sprite_control_words
description: Computes sprite coordinates from an object position relative to base values, using different constants from the other sprite routine, and writes a four-byte sprite control record with flag bits. It writes an identical copy 328 bytes further on.

name: decrement_countdown_and_call
description: Decrements a global countdown when it is nonzero. When the countdown reaches zero it calls a routine, clears a global state, and calls two more routines.
